text: 亨通光电公告，控股股东亨通集团有限公司计划自公告披露之日起12个月内，通过上海证券交易所系统以集中竞价方式增持公司A股，拟增持金额不低于人民币4亿元（含）且不超过人民币6亿元（含），资金来源为自有资金和/或自筹资金，增持数量及比例以实际交易情况为准。增持计划实施期间，亨通集团承诺不减持所持公司股份；如公司股票因筹划重大事项连续停牌10个交易日以上，计划在股票复牌后顺延实施。该计划不会导致公司控股股东及实际控制人发生变化。
text_en: Hengtong Optic-Electric announced that controlling shareholder Hengtong Group Co., Ltd. plans to increase its holdings of the company's A-shares through centralized competitive bidding via the Shanghai Stock Exchange system within 12 months from the date of the announcement, with a planned increase of no less than 400 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 600 million yuan (inclusive). The source of funds is its own funds and/or self-raised funds, and the number and proportion of shares increased shall be subject to actual transactions. During the implementation of the increase plan, Hengtong Group promises not to reduce its holdings of the company's shares; if the company's stock is suspended for more than 10 consecutive trading days due to planning major matters, the plan will be extended after trading resumes. The plan will not cause a change in the company's controlling shareholder or actual controller.
